name: OnOff
tagline: Twenty-five rooms. Flip the world. Don't touch the spikes.
description:
A little robot, two layers of platforms, and a button that swaps which one is solid. Walk, jump, toggle. Spikes kill you. The door at the other side is the level.

Twenty-five hand-made rooms from the 2018 js13kGames jam. On a phone: left, right, jump, and ON/OFF under your thumbs. On a computer it is WASD or the arrows, space to flip.

An unofficial port of OnOff by Daniel Marino and Brad Dunbar, MIT-licensed. Close it, come back: how far you got is still in the file.
